metadata.description: Project-agnostic Claude Code skill packs: sdlc, migration, pm, vibe

plugins.name: sdlc-standard
plugins.description: Project-agnostic SDLC pack for building something new, P0 Inception to P9 Maintenance: requirements, basic/detail design, implementation, test levels, UAT, change requests, traceability.

plugins.name: migration-standard
plugins.description: Pack for rewriting or replatforming a legacy system where behaviour must be preserved: legacy analysis, gap-driven design, no-invention rules, read-only legacy guards.

plugins.name: pm-standard
plugins.description: PMBOK-aligned project management pack: charter, scope/WBS, estimation, cost and schedule baselines, EVM, reporting, quality, risk, change control, closing.

plugins.name: vibe-standard
plugins.description: Vibe coding with guard rails: intent -> slice -> run -> verify -> commit, stage model spike/prototype/mvp/production, debt ledger, and handoff to sdlc/pm when the project outgrows it.
